typography.description: Playfair Display provides the elegant, high-contrast serif editorial feel matching the reference. Manrope acts as a clean, highly legible, complementary geometric sans for body copy.

type_scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-serif tracking-tighter leading-tight text-charcoal
type_scale.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight text-charcoal
type_scale.eyebrow: text-xs sm:text-sm font-sans tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-bold text-charcoal

visual_enhancers.shadows: Very soft ambient shadows only where necessary (e.g., shadow-[0_10px_40px_rgba(28,27,26,0.05)]). Prefer flat overlapping layers with thin borders over heavy shadows.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Large rounded corners for cards and some image blocks. Use rounded-3xl or rounded-[32px] for structural cards. Buttons should be pill-shaped (rounded-full).
visual_enhancers.textures: Clean, airy, breathable. No heavy gradients or noise. Rely on the warmth of the background hex codes.

layouts.general_spacing: Generous vertical rhythm. Use py-20 md:py-32 for section padding. Container px-6 md:px-12 max-w-7xl mx-auto.
layouts.hero: Asymmetric split. Text on left spanning 7 columns. White-background portrait on right spanning 5 columns, overlapping the bottom edge slightly. Top announcement bar.
layouts.eyebrow_labels: Format as '/ SECTION NAME /' with slashes included in text. Example: '/ ABOUT YOU /'.
layouts.image_collages: Overlapping photos. Use absolute positioning. Example: Main photo relative z-10 w-3/4. Secondary dark-bg photo absolute -bottom-12 -right-6 w-1/2 z-20 border-8 border-[#EFE9E1]. Mixed rounded and sharp corners.
layouts.services_cards: Large rounded-3xl cards bg-[#E5DCCF] p-8 md:p-10. Elements flow: Title -> description -> Caramel solid pill button.
layouts.testimonials: Carousel with large elegant serif quote. Custom circular left/right arrow buttons below quote. Background #F5F2ED.

motion.entrance: Subtle fade up and in for text and images using Framer Motion (initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}). Stagger children.
motion.hover: Buttons scale up slightly (scale-105) with transition-transform. Cards have no hover lift, keeping the editorial flat feel, but buttons inside react.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against #A9784E accent color is readable. Use #FFFFFF text on the #A9784E button, which provides an elegant look. For smaller text, use #1C1B1A on #A9784E if needed. All main body text is #1C1B1A on #EFE9E1 (extremely high contrast).

media.image_treatment: Lifestyle photography should feel natural, warm, and sunlit. Kendra's existing white-background hero portrait should be placed seamlessly on the #EFE9E1 background, perhaps utilizing mix-blend-multiply if the background of the image is pure white, or positioned creatively to embrace the cutout style.

instructions_to_main_agent: Set the background of the entire app to #EFE9E1.
Import Google Fonts 'Playfair Display' and 'Manrope' in index.css or via layout wrapper.
Build a fixed navigation bar with a deep header feel, containing brand logo/name on left, main links center, and 'Trainer Login' + CTA on right.
The Hero section must include an Announcement Bar at the very top. Add the white-bg portrait creatively, maybe with mix-blend-multiply to blend into the cream background.
Create the '/ ABOUT YOU /' section as a bulleted list with elegant checkmarks or custom markers.
The 'What Makes This Different' block should feature a massive Playfair Display headline.
For the Services section, create 6 specific cards: 1:1 Training, Small Group, Online Coaching, Pre & Postnatal, Nutrition, Mind·Body·Soul. Use #E5DCCF background and rounded-3xl for these cards.
Build a Testimonials carousel using Framer Motion or a simple React state, including circular left/right buttons.
Ensure the contact form at the bottom uses Shadcn UI Form/Input components but styled with warm borders (border-[#DCD4C7]), no Vercel-default styling. Form MUST post to '/api/leads'.
Add 'Trainer Login' and 'Designed by Mo Studio' in the Footer.
Use standard semantic HTML sections (<section>, <header>, <footer>). DO NOT OVER-COMPONENTIZE the marketing layout with Shadcn structural components.
Implement data-testid on all interactive elements as requested (e.g. data-testid='contact-submit-button', data-testid='nav-login-link').

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends. Do not use dark colors as gradients. Don't make generic centered layouts. Add transition for specific interactive elements. You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). You MUST NOT center align the app container. Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons with interaction animations. Every interaction needs micro-animations. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters. Main agent relies on provided image URLs, do not use placeholder text.
